summary.text: Sentiment skews cautiously greedy as speculative traders pile into Microsoft calls and leveraged crypto proxies ahead of July earnings, betting on an IV spike and recovery despite visible underwater positions across the board.

A sharp semiconductor selloff has bruised margin-fueled longs in AMD, Broadcom, and chip names, producing painful account blow-ups even as a Cerebras growth report and AI narrative keep the upside story alive.

SpaceX-linked SPCX trades split the crowd between profit-takers and bears, while macro undertones — rising private credit redemptions and nuclear power deals — add a layer of more sober institutional flavor to the speculative froth.
